results.detail: Create FundEnrolment For Transfer Request has DTS:Disabled=True (DTSX:8160). Its Insert To TemporaryTable runs 'insert into ##TblFundEnrolments (gen_fundenrolmentid) values(?)' on [CRM], with errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:10191-10199). The other two flows insert into TblFundEnrolments on [SRS.GENERIX_STAGING] (DTSX:3578-3583, 7098-7103). Update FundEnrolment reads 'select * from TblFundEnrolments' on [SRS.GENERIX_STAGING] (DTSX:13755-13756) and sets gen_ismailsend = 0 (main.cs:122-126). A grep of all 35 supplied DTSX finds ##TblFundEnrolments only at DTSX:10191, so nothing creates it. Constraints 6 and 7 are Success (no Value) and lead to Update Reject Management and Update FundEnrolment (DTSX:15645-15646). The '##' = tempdb statement is standard SQL Server behaviour. Note: the claim correctly avoids saying whether the failure would occur at validation/prepare time or per row.

Units 1-8 are correct. [1] where (gen_lastsyncdate is null or gen_lastsyncdate < aj.ModifiedOn) and aj.gen_joiningstatus = 2 (DTSX:3357-3418). [2]-[4] Is Fundenrolment Exits is a full-cache Lookup on gen_fundenrolment.gen_automatedjoining, and only its No Match output is connected. [6] the 'No CreateRow' condition requires JoiningStatus != 2, which can never happen. [8] Update Owner sets OwnerId = RejectTeamId, OwnerIdType = 9 (DTSX:4696). The 1:N left join to gen_transferrequest in [9] is correct. Unit 9, however, states unconditionally that every source row gets a record. Create gen_fundEnrolment catches every exception (SoapException or Exception, main.cs:282-291) and sends the row to CastingError, and that output is not connected. Rows whose creation fails therefore produce no record and leave no trace. Possible causes are a CRM fault, DateTime.ParseExact on gen_closedate/gen_receivingdate, and Guid.Parse(Variables.RejectTeamId). This is the same reason the Pension short was made conditional ('כשהיצירה מצליחה').

wrongUnits.problem: The outcome is stated unconditionally ('לכל שורת מקור ... נפתחת רשומת טיפול'), but failed creations are silently dropped through the unconnected CastingError output.
wrongUnits.correct: When creation succeeds, each source row (an automated joining in status 2 without a Fund Enrolment) gets a new record. The record is reassigned by SQL to the reject team, and its id is stored for the gen_ismailsend marking. If creation fails, the row is dropped without a record or a log. A joining with several transfer requests appears in several rows and can get several records in the same run.

results.detail: [1] matches the WHERE clause at DTSX:6934-6937. [2]-[6] match main.cs:136-151: the referent with OwnerIdType 8 and joiningstatus 17, or else RejectTeamId with type 9 and the pj status copied when it is not null. [7]-[8] match the field set and the multicast to Update Fund Enrolment Owner and Upate Pension Joining (DTSX:8100, 8056). [9] is correctly conditional on success. It says one record per joining: the source has one row per pension joining, because the rm subquery is limited to Row_Num = 1 and the other joins go to primary keys. Repeats in later runs are prevented by gen_fundenrolmentid is null. See the Set gen_note caveat on |detailed; this short stays correct only because it is conditional on success.

All stated facts check out against the source. Source WHERE: DTSX:6934-6937. Product subqueries: '200003' and '200004'. Owner and status branches: main.cs:136-151. Product branch: 166-173. Fields: 153-278. Newsletter, pension and employers-file flags: 281-294. Underwriting branches: 296-325 (123456). try/catch: 132/330-334, with CustingError not connected. Unchecked null reads: main.cs:138 (DTSX:5020) and 169/171. SQL updates: DTSX:8100 OwnerId=?, OwnerIdType=? and DTSX:8056. Staging insert: DTSX:7098. What is missing: unit 30 rests on the premise that reading a NULL buffer column throws, for the Guid at main.cs:138. The upstream Set gen_note script (DTSX:7153, code at DTSX:7396-7406, main.cs:119-128) reads Row.genrejectionreason1Name..4Name and Row.genrejectreasonsnotes inside String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(...) without any _IsNull check, and it has no try/catch and no error output. By the generated wrapper these reads are Buffer.GetString(...) (DTSX:7621ff). Under the same premise, any row with a NULL in any of those five columns throws in Set gen_note. That is typical, because the WHERE needs only one of the reasons, the notes or a reject-management row. The exception fails the component and the whole data flow. Then, via the Success chain, Close FundEnrolments For Pension, Update Reject Management With Fund Enrolment, Update FundEnrolment (gen_ismailsend) and End ETL do not run. Unit 3 presents note-building as safe, and units 30 and 36 omit this failure path. If GetString on NULL does not throw, the premise of unit 30 for main.cs:138 would also need re-examination. Either way the text is not internally consistent. The SSIS runtime assembly is not in scope, so the claim must at least state this conditionally.

wrongUnits.problem: The business outcome omits the case where the pension flow aborts in Set gen_note.
wrongUnits.correct: When creation succeeds, a pension joining with a reject gets a handling record assigned to the relevant owner. If Create fails (for example, passed-and-reject with an empty updating referent, or a missing pension product), no record is created and the failure is not logged. If Set gen_note meets a NULL reason name or a NULL note (read without an _IsNull check), the whole data flow fails and the later steps of the package do not run in that run.

When gen_feedbackstatus is NULL and an active course has error 11879018, the inner expression is UNKNOWN, NOT UNKNOWN is UNKNOWN, and the row is also excluded. results.id: L|Package\Update Reject Management With Fund Enrolment|detailed
results.detail: Units 1-9 match the 3-part UNION (DTSX:14666-14686): the isoldrejectmethod filter (!= 1 or null) on aj, pj and tr; rm with gen_fundenrolmentid null and statecode 0; and the script at main.cs:120-127, an SDK Update of gen_rejectmanagement.gen_fundenrolmentid. Two things are missing. (a) Part 1 joins gen_fundenrolmentbase on fe.Gen_automatedjoining = aj id, and an automated joining can have several Fund Enrolments: finding#4 and Create Fundenrolment|short [9] say several can be created in one run. The UNION then yields one (rm, fe) row per Fund Enrolment, and the same reject-management record is updated once per row. The final link is whichever update runs last, in an undefined order. Unit 11 ('attached to its source's handling record', singular) omits this. (b) Unit 10: the Failure output column ErrorMessage is wstr(200) (DTSX:15623). The catch assigns ex.Message (main.cs:133, DTSX:15057), and a message longer than 200 characters throws inside the catch. That fails the component and the data flow, so Update FundEnrolment (gen_ismailsend) and End ETL do not run (Constraints 7 and 9). So a failure is not always just 'routed to a dead-end column'. This is the same pattern the 0032 analysis documents for wstr(100).
results.evidence: DTSX:14666-14686; 14715 main.cs:116-136 (DTSX:15057); Failure.ErrorMessage wstr(200) DTSX:15623; DTSX:15646-15648; finding#4

wrongUnits.problem: This holds only if the exception message fits in 200 characters.
wrongUnits.correct: An update failure is routed to the Failure output, an empty Derived Column with no continuation, if ex.Message fits in ErrorMessage wstr(200). Otherwise the assignment throws inside the catch, the data flow fails, and the gen_ismailsend marking (Update FundEnrolment) does not run.

wrongUnits.problem: Omits the case of an automated joining with several Fund Enrolments.
wrongUnits.correct: Add: if an automated joining has more than one Fund Enrolment, which can happen when it has several transfer requests, its reject-management record is updated once per Fund Enrolment. The last update wins, and the order is not defined.
